gaps: Köln: Blumenberg, Roggendorf/Thenhoven, Godorf, Libur not published (<3 sales) → 'too few sales' note.
Köln: Immendorf (n=4) and Lindweiler (n=3) have no €/m² (living area unknown); Elsdorf has Neubau only.
Köln: 13 Stadtteile with resale n<10 (Hahnwald, Meschenich, Vogelsang, Fühlingen, Merkenich, Volkhoven/Weiler, Worringen, Langel, Buchforst, Flittard, Stammheim + the 2 above) → not used.
Köln: ranges are min–max, not a typical (IQR-like) range → different copy; 'below/above range' rarely triggers.
Köln: Finkenberg and Seeberg have no OSM admin_level-10 polygon → matched by name only, never via PLZ.
Köln: city-wide resale/new-build means are our n-weighted calculation from the Stadtteil rows; the official 2025 city mean (4,709) mixes all segments.
Both: PLZ shares are land area, not number of flats; OSM data ODbL (attribution on method page).
